run_curate_nuscenes_eval: run the script to process nuScenes LiDAR samples into depth maps and JSONL metadata
create_depth_map_from_points: create a depth map from projected LiDAR points and their depth values
map_pointcloud_to_image: map a LiDAR pointcloud to image coordinates using camera calibration data
process_nuscenes_sample: process a single nuScenes sample to extract depth map and camera intrinsics
process_multiple_nuscenes_samples: process multiple nuScenes samples and save images and depth data to JSONL
